name: RLE Accelerated Sheet Buffer Splatting
aliases: RLE accelerated, pre-classification and pre-shade sheet buffer volume splatting
pre-classification and pre-shade sheet buffer volume splatting
definition: A volume splatting algorithm that accelerates rendering by using Run Length Encoding (RLE) to skip transparent voxels, combined with a sheet buffer approach that traverses voxel scanlines and image scanlines simultaneously. It uses pre-classification and pre-shading to move computation out of the rendering loop.
summary: RLE Accelerated Sheet Buffer Splatting is a volume rendering algorithm that accelerates splatting by using Run Length Encoding to skip transparent regions and maintaining three RLE sets for flexible, parallel sheet buffer updates.
